snippet.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Join Geralt of Rivia on the Path in the newly remastered edition of the genre-defining RPG. With improvements to visuals, gameplay, interface, and much more, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered is the definitive way to experience Geralt's legendary journey.

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered is out now on GOG, Steam, Epic Games Store, Battle.net, PlayStation 5, XBOX Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2. It’s available as a free upgrade for players who already own The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt on supported platforms and includes two acclaimed expansions — Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine.
